message.earth_human.status.hint: §7Water and rehydration items restore hydration; standing rest, daytime naps and night sleep reduce fatigue; bandages and first aid kits treat body-part injuries.
message.earth_human.help.title: §eEarth Human v0.1.19 development build guide
message.earth_human.help.status: §7/earthhuman status: open the full status panel. /eh status text: show the text view.
message.earth_human.help.body: §7/earthhuman body: show head, torso, limbs and specific injury conditions. The core leaves vanilla health unchanged; body-health splitting is an optional add-on.
message.earth_human.help.training: §7/eh training: show body-part training level and current load. /eh exercise squat, push_up, core and stretch test exercise actions directly; bands, dumbbells and mats also work by right-click.
message.earth_human.help.settings: §7/eh settings: open the body HUD settings page for corner, size, opacity and visibility.
message.earth_human.help.thirst: §7Hydration declines over time. Sprinting and the Nether drain it faster. Carry a filled canteen, rehydration salts or drinks.
message.earth_human.help.fatigue: §7Walking, sprinting, swimming and climbing build fatigue from actual distance; riding and elytra are lighter. Short stops do not clear continuous load; real rest, stretching and sleep lower it gradually.
message.earth_human.help.temperature: §7The Nether is hot; rain and water are cold. Heat packs, blankets and cooling packs are temporary tools; leaving the extreme environment is the real fix.
message.earth_human.help.air_quality: §7Smoke, mining dust, the Nether and underwater conditions lower air quality. Equip a mask in the head slot to filter smoke and dust; clean air restores it slowly.
message.earth_human.help.arcana: §7With the Xuanhuan or Magic branches installed, fasting, body tempering, breath training and arcane wards automatically improve hunger pressure, fatigue, temperature stress and underwater breathing.
message.earth_human.sleep.nap_start: §bYou start a short nap. Daytime naps recover fatigue without skipping the day.
message.earth_human.training.title: §e=== Earth Human / Training Status ===
message.earth_human.training.hint: §7Using a body part slowly trains it; too much load can cause muscle strain. Actions: %s.
message.earth_human.training.too_fast: §eToo fast. Catch your breath first. Forcing reps makes strain more likely.
message.earth_human.training.disabled: §eTraining is disabled by the server. This item remains available but will not add training load.

message.earth_human.training.strain: §c%s was overtrained and developed muscle strain. This is an Earth Human custom status, not only vanilla weakness/slowness.

message.earth_human.body.title: §e=== Earth Human / Body Condition ===
message.earth_human.body.vanilla_head: §7The core leaves vanilla health untouched and tracks body integrity and specific injuries separately. Body-health splitting is provided by the optional Body Health add-on.
message.earth_human.body.hint: §7High falls mainly injure the legs and affect movement without weakening the hands. Bare-hand hard-stone mining or bare-hand cactus contact can injure the right hand and slow mining without slowing movement.
message.earth_human.body.failed: §c%s is disabled: this will not kill you directly, but continued use or further hits can strain adjacent parts. Use a bandage or first aid kit soon.

message.earth_human.body.spread.impact: §cThe impact to %s strained %s. Use a bandage / first aid kit to stop it getting worse.

message.earth_human.injury.leg.serious: §cSerious leg injury, possibly a fracture: movement is much slower, but the hands are unaffected.
message.earth_human.injury.right_hand.st: §eRight-hand injury detected: bare-hand mining is affected. Rest or care can help it recover.
message.earth_human.injury.right_hand.se: §cSerious right-hand injury: mining is much slower, but walking is unaffected.

screen.earth_human.guide.title: Earth Human · Field Guide
screen.earth_human.guide.body.title: Reading body status
screen.earth_human.guide.body.body: The core keeps the vanilla health bar and does not turn normal combat into split health. It tracks head, torso and limb integrity, plus leg and right-hand injuries. High falls mainly affect the legs; bare-hand hard-stone mining or bare-hand cactus contact can affect the right hand.
screen.earth_human.guide.vitals.title: Hydration, temperature and fatigue
screen.earth_human.guide.vitals.body: Hydration falls with time, movement and heat. Rehydration drinks, oral salts and canteens restore it. Temperature responds to the Nether, rain and water; heat or cooling packs are temporary buffers. When fatigue is high, stop sprinting and mining. Standing rest, a daytime nap or night sleep can restore it.
screen.earth_human.guide.care.title: What to do after an injury
screen.earth_human.guide.care.body: Open the body status screen and choose Quick Care. Bandages prioritize the most severe non-head injury, while a first-aid kit can treat the head. Care takes time and the server checks the exact item again before consuming it. You can cancel an active care action.
screen.earth_human.guide.activity.title: Activity and training
screen.earth_human.guide.activity.body: Walking, sprinting, swimming, climbing, jumping, attacking and mining create different loads and train related regions. A short pause does not instantly clear continuous load. Overtraining can cause muscle strain; rest, stretching and suitable recovery items help.
screen.earth_human.guide.environment.bod: Smoke and mining dust lower air quality, while the Nether and underwater conditions add breathing pressure. Right-click a cloth or dust mask in your hand to equip it in the head slot; the dust mask filters more strongly. Air quality recovers after leaving the source. Masks do not replace underwater breathing or prevent every environmental damage type.
screen.earth_human.guide.compatibility.b: In the core, zombie melee, arrows, explosions, armor, max health, healing and death remain entirely owned by Minecraft and other mods; they add no hit-location injury. The optional Body Health add-on consumes only final damage after vanilla armor and potion reduction, avoiding double mitigation.
